note: Learned layer over foundation's HI-Graph. foundation is the literature prior and is never edited; everything here was produced by measurement inside the loop.

subject: Case Assignment
contradictions.prior_said: Case Assignment has a weak positive impact on time.
contradictions.measured_said: The measured time effect was mixed to harmful: CA-001 worsened throughput and waiting, while CA-002 was flat and CA-004 had no throughput improvement.
evidence: CA-001 sole-owned activity worsened by 0.5005 h/case, z=7.87
CA-001 increased A_Incomplete waiting, z=5.83, and A_Validating waiting, z=9.69
CA-002 throughput was nonsignificant and CA-004 sole-owned throughput was nonsignificant
contradictions.note: The prior's positive time direction is not reliable for this measured case-assignment pattern; resource-pool merging can create contention that dominates handover savings.

subject: Contact Reduction
contradictions.prior_said: Contact Reduction has a strong positive impact on time.
contradictions.measured_said: CR-002 made simulated throughput and waiting worse despite the separately reported exogenous log estimate.
evidence: CR-002 O_Sent waiting worsened, z=3.54
CR-002 throughput worsened by 0.0071 h/case, z=3.50
The log separately estimates 9.9686 h/case of exogenous saving, which was not netted into the simulated ranking
contradictions.note: The exogenous saving remains a reported estimate, but it does not support the simulated time-direction prior for CR-002.

subject: Specialize
contradictions.prior_said: Specialize has a weak positive impact on time because faster performers reduce service time.
contradictions.measured_said: Specialization was harmful in the built model because the smaller resource pool increased shared waiting; removing SPC-001 improved the affected activity.
evidence: Removing SPC-001 changed W_Complete application waiting from +0.9644 to -0.0266 h/case, z=-3.56
Phase-3 verdict for SPC-001 was hurt
The detector's service-time saving was 0.2632 h per occurrence, but the simulation measured queueing harm
contradictions.note: Service-time improvement alone does not justify a positive overall time prior when specialization changes queueing.

subject: Activity Composition
contradictions.prior_said: Activity Composition has a weak positive impact on time.
contradictions.measured_said: The built activity-composition edits helped throughput without significant resource movement.
evidence: AC-001 improved sole-owned activity hours by 1.4354 h/case, z=-107.85
AC-002 improved sole-owned activity hours by 0.4324 h/case, z=-60.34
Both Phase-3 candidates were measured as helped

subject: Activity Elimination
contradictions.prior_said: Activity Elimination has a strong positive impact on time.
contradictions.measured_said: Removing W_Handle leads improved the attributable activity-time measure.
evidence: AE-002 improved sole-owned activity hours by 0.1783 h/case, z=-42.8
AE-002 Phase-3 verdict was helped
contradictions.note: The strong positive time prior held up.

subject: Case-based Work
contradictions.prior_said: Case-based Work has a strong positive impact on time by removing batching delays.
contradictions.measured_said: The built case-based-work edits improved waiting and, for CBW-002, throughput and duration as well.
evidence: CBW-002 waiting improved, z=-6.35
CBW-002 duration improved, z=-3.44
CBW-002 sole-owned throughput improved, z=-4.86
CBW-001 confirmation run improved W_Complete application waiting, z=-3.56
contradictions.note: The positive time prior was supported by multiple built candidates.

subject: Contact Reduction
Interfacing
contradictions.prior_said: Contact Reduction and Interfacing are a hard conflict when they affect the same activity.
contradictions.measured_said: The condition fired on O_Sent (online only); CR-002 was built and IF-001 was skipped because the gateway had already been re-rated.
evidence: get_pair_relation reported HARD_CONFLICT with condition_fires=true and shared activity O_Sent (online only)
Phase-3 built CR-002
Phase-3 skipped IF-001 because CR-002 had already re-rated the same gateway
contradictions.note: The hard structural conflict was not refuted; both edits were not built together.

subject: Case-based Work
contradictions.prior_said: Case-based work has a strong positive time impact.
contradictions.measured_said: Case-based work improved throughput when individually attributable, while covered candidates did not show individually separable effects.
evidence: CBW-002 improved throughput by 0.3139 h/case with z=-5.05.
The whole plan improved median throughput with z=-5.07.
Phase-3 built CBW-001, CBW-002, and CBW-003 successfully.
contradictions.note: The time prior held up; attribution remains limited for CBW-001 and CBW-003.

subject: Activity Composition
contradictions.prior_said: Activity composition has a weak positive time impact.
contradictions.measured_said: Both composition candidates were helped, with individually attributable throughput improvement.
evidence: AC-001 footprint-owned activity hours improved by 1.4354 h/case with z=-107.85.
AC-002 own A_Pending measure improved by 0.0388 h/case with z=-14.22.
Phase-3 built AC-001 and AC-002 successfully.
contradictions.note: The measured results support the weak positive time prior.

subject: Case Assignment
contradictions.prior_said: Case Assignment has a weak positive time impact.
contradictions.measured_said: The time effect was mixed: CA-001 caused significant harm, CA-002 caused contention, and CA-004 improved waiting.
evidence: CA-001 sole-owner throughput worsened with z=5.69 and A_Validating waiting worsened with z=7.94.
CA-002 A_Concept waiting worsened with z=6.04.
CA-004 improved footprint-owned waiting with z=-11.40 and z=-3.01.
contradictions.note: Revise the generic time impact from weak_positive to neutral or explicitly heterogeneous; case assignment is not reliably time-improving.

subject: Contact Reduction
contradictions.prior_said: Contact Reduction has a strong positive time impact.
contradictions.measured_said: Both contact-reduction candidates worsened simulated operational measures, although the log separately estimates exogenous waiting savings.
evidence: CR-001 O_Cancelled waiting still rose with z=3.82.
CR-002 O_Sent waiting worsened with z=3.26 and throughput worsened with z=3.27.
The whole-plan throughput improved with z=-5.07, but the candidate-level CR-002 result was independently harmful and its 9.9686 h/case estimate is not simulated.
contradictions.note: Revise simulated time impact from strong_positive to neutral or weak_negative; retain the exogenous log estimates as separately reported evidence, not as a ranking input.

subject: Case Assignment
Contact Reduction
contradictions.prior_said: The pair has a weak conflict when both edits affect a shared activity.
contradictions.measured_said: The condition fired on O_Cancelled, Phase-3 built both edits, and shared activity contention was measured.
evidence: get_pair_relation reported WEAK_CONFLICT with condition_fires=true and shared activity O_Cancelled.
Phase-3 built CA-001 and CR-001 successfully, so no hard incompatibility was observed.
O_Cancelled waiting rose by 0.198 h/case with z=22.52.
contradictions.note: The weak-conflict relation was supported; the successful build rules out upgrading it to a hard conflict.

subject: Case Assignment
contradictions.prior_said: Case Assignment has a weak-positive time impact because assigning a case to one resource reduces handover overhead.
contradictions.measured_said: The measured time effect was harmful or contended: CA-002 increased A_Concept waiting and worsened W_Complete application waiting and duration, while CA-004 increased O_Returned waiting.
evidence: CA-002 A_Concept waiting increased with z=7.76
CA-002 W_Complete application waiting worsened with z=4.40 and duration with z=4.17
CA-004 O_Returned waiting increased with z=3.73
Phase-3 built both CA-002 and CA-004 successfully
contradictions.note: Revise the time impact away from weak-positive toward mixed or uncertain; the evidence supports contention and queueing harm rather than the predicted improvement.

subject: Contact Reduction
contradictions.prior_said: Contact Reduction has a strong-positive time impact because consolidating contacts removes repeated wall-clock waiting.
contradictions.measured_said: The simulated operational effect was not consistently positive: CR-001 increased O_Cancelled waiting and produced a small throughput worsening, while CR-002 was flat on throughput; the separately estimated exogenous savings are not simulated evidence.
evidence: CR-001 O_Cancelled waiting increased with z=4.29
CR-001 throughput increased by +0.019 h/case with z=2.83, indicating a small nonsignificant worsening
CR-002 throughput was flat and resources improved
Phase-3 built CR-001 and CR-002 successfully
contradictions.note: Revise the simulated time impact from strong-positive toward mixed or uncertain. Retain the log-based exogenous savings as a separate reported estimate, not as evidence that the simulator measured improvement.

subject: Activity Composition
contradictions.prior_said: Activity Composition has a weak-positive time impact because merging consecutive activities removes a seam or handover.
contradictions.measured_said: Both Activity Composition candidates improved measured throughput without resource deterioration.
evidence: AC-001 edited activities improved by -1.4354 h/case with z=-107.85
AC-002 A_Pending improved by -0.0388 h/case with z=-14.22
Phase-3 built AC-001 and AC-002 successfully
contradictions.note: The time-direction prior held up, although the aggregate plan effect remains modest and other dimensions were not directly established.

subject: Case-based Work
contradictions.prior_said: Case-based Work has a strong-positive time impact because switching from batch to case-by-case processing removes queueing delays.
contradictions.measured_said: The measured evidence is directionally compatible: the plan significantly reduced waiting, and the Case-based Work edit shared an improvement on O_Accepted, though marginal causation was not proven.
evidence: Whole-plan waiting decreased by 0.4879 h/case with z=-5.95
CBW-003 shared an O_Accepted improvement of -0.3935 h/case
Phase-3 built CBW-003 successfully
CBW-003's batch component was measured with z=40.2 in the log evidence
contradictions.note: The prior is supported directionally but not isolated causally from AC-002, so no stronger update is warranted.
